_comment: FSDP config for Qwen3-32B on 8-node × 8×H100 (64 GPUs).
_note_ulysses: Ulysses sequence parallelism is handled separately via veScale, not via this config.
_shard_size_note: FSDP2 full_shard with shard_size=8 means weights sharded across all 64 GPUs (8 nodes × 8 GPUs). Set via --fsdp 'full_shard auto_wrap' in TrainingArguments.
